information: ### After 32 competitions at Strathclyde, this weekend we celebrate the swan song of a much-loved venue. Please join us for 4 days of competing as we bid it a fond farewell! #### This competition runs Saturday - Tuesday, however competitors are welcome to attend as many days of the event as they wish and more popular events will take place on the Saturday and Sunday. ##### Please note that there is a competitor limit in place at this competition for 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blind of 20 competitors per event. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Kewbz.global](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYxOTcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6829e6558c1a5ecf99757e5e61782b466ebc9d7c/kewbzglobal.png)](https://kewbz.global)
